SshPasswordPrompt extends Context.Service; in VibeLang a service is a service declaration: service SshPasswordPrompt { … }.
  No quick fix: move its static members into the declaration. Keep its key in the declaration: static readonly key = "@t3tools/ssh/auth/SshPasswordPrompt".

Effect.map(Number) infers an Effect in a plain function's generic parameter, so the function receives the unrun program instead of its result.
  Run the Effect with try where it is constructed, or write the Effect type argument explicitly to pass the program itself.
